LUT data will be written into this file. The following filename extensions are recognized:
  • .3dl : Autodesk/Scratch format
  • .blut : Houdini mplay blut format
  • .cms : CMS file format (includes the 1D LUT).
  • .csp : CineSpace format
  • .cub : Truelight LUT format
  • .cube : Iridas LUT format
  • .vf : Nuke's Vectorfield operator
If the file type is blank, the format will be guessed from the filename, but you will not be able to set any type-specific controls.

description.text:
Generate Color Management Lookup Tables.

Input must be the output of a CMSTestPattern operator, passed through a sequence of operators that produce the desired color correction.

The size of the 3D LUT is controlled by the Test Pattern generator node, not this one. This node looks at the size of the image it gets and figures out the size of LUT to be generated.

The following extensions/file formats are recognized:
  • .3dl : Autodesk/Scratch format
  • .blut : Houdini mplay blut format
  • .cms : CMS file format (includes the 1D LUT).
  • .csp : CineSpace format
  • .cub : Truelight LUT format
  • .cube : Iridas LUT format
  • .vf : Nuke's Vectorfield operator
